correctness.rationale: The explicit synchronous firing recurrence is checked at times 0…m: F0 excludes only the hub, and for 1≤t<m, the hub and all peripherals fire except one zero at position t on each petal longer than t. The hub chip count 2k−1−N(t) remains ≥k until t=m−1 and becomes k−1 at time m, recovering the initial configuration. A fixed maximum-length petal gives each time s∈[1,m−1] a vertex omitted only from F_s, while the hub is omitted only at s=0. Therefore the m simplex facets have empty total intersection and every proper subintersection nonempty; the nerve is ∂Δ^{m−1}≈S^{m−2}. Each initial subfamily of fewer than m simplices shares a vertex, so the time-filtration is a cone then acquires the single permanent sphere; the additional hub chip forces F0=V. The finite 3900-case verification is corroboration rather than infinite proof.
residual_risks: Does not address other configurations, orientations, or graphs beyond the directed bouquets.
